how_it_typically_prints: Online Statements from the Accounts menu opens Online Statements & Documents, filtered by document type and year; check images and other enclosures sit on a separate Enclosures tab
what_breaks_when_converting: Enclosures downloaded with the statement and treated as more pages to convert
check_that_catches_it: Convert the statement only; its Checks section already lists every check paid

how_it_typically_prints: Typically Beginning Balance, Deposits & Credits, Withdrawals, Fees, Automatic Transfers, Checks, Ending Balance
what_breaks_when_converting: Five detail sections pasted in section order, so no running balance ever works
check_that_catches_it: Beginning + Deposits & Credits - Withdrawals - Fees - Automatic Transfers - Checks = Ending

how_it_typically_prints: Amounts print without a sign; the section heading says which way the money moved
what_breaks_when_converting: Sections combined and every withdrawal reads as a deposit
check_that_catches_it: Each section total matches its summary line once the sign comes from the section

how_it_typically_prints: Written out, such as September 1, 2026 through September 30, 2026; detail dates are short
what_breaks_when_converting: Rows on a December to January statement get the wrong year
check_that_catches_it: Year taken from the period line

how_it_typically_prints: Free Web Connect files for Quicken and QuickBooks, transactions for the dates picked
what_breaks_when_converting: No beginning or ending balance, so a missing row can go unnoticed
check_that_catches_it: Use the PDF when the month has to be proven

how_it_typically_prints: In a copy we have seen: Date, Check #, Transaction Description, Details, Credits, Debits, Balance
what_breaks_when_converting: Credits and Debits are both positive, so a pasted SUM means nothing
check_that_catches_it: Beginning + Credits - Debits = Ending, and each row agrees with the printed Balance beside it

how_it_typically_prints: Extra text such as the ACH company name printed under the transaction
what_breaks_when_converting: Pasted as a row of its own with no date and no amount
check_that_catches_it: A line with no amount belongs to the description above it

how_it_typically_prints: A separate statement for many business accounts explaining the prior period's service charges and any earnings credit, posted after the fifth business day
what_breaks_when_converting: Fee detail imported as transactions, so the charge is counted twice
check_that_catches_it: Only the Service Charges - Prior Period line on the checking statement is a row

how_it_typically_prints: Up to 18 months of transactions, usually no balances
what_breaks_when_converting: Nothing to prove the list against
check_that_catches_it: Use the statement PDF from Documents

how_it_typically_prints: Truist formed from BB&T and SunTrust, merger effective December 6, 2019; older statements carry those names
what_breaks_when_converting: Old statements set aside as the wrong bank
check_that_catches_it: Convert them as they are; the printed bank name doesn't change the proof

how_it_typically_prints: Huntington's own sample statement prints Credits (+), Debits (-) and Total Fees (-) in the summary and Deposit / Credit Activity (+) as a heading
what_breaks_when_converting: The (+) or (-) stays behind in the heading when rows are copied
check_that_catches_it: Beginning + Credits - Debits - Total Fees = Ending

how_it_typically_prints: Fees on their own summary line, apart from debits
what_breaks_when_converting: A fee counted once as a debit and again as a fee
check_that_catches_it: Debits and fees each tie to their own summary line

how_it_typically_prints: Average Balance and Low Balance printed in the summary
what_breaks_when_converting: Read as amounts that moved
check_that_catches_it: They describe the month; only activity rows count

how_it_typically_prints: Typically a Relationship Summary of every account up front and a Balance Activity grid of dated balances
what_breaks_when_converting: Balances from other accounts or the grid imported as rows
check_that_catches_it: Rows come from the activity sections only

how_it_typically_prints: Citizens Bank, N.A., Providence, Rhode Island; not Citi, First Citizens or Citizens Business Bank
what_breaks_when_converting: Download steps followed for the wrong bank
check_that_catches_it: Check the bank name on the PDF before converting

how_it_typically_prints: Typically Previous Balance, Checks, Debits, Deposits & Credits, Interest Paid, Current Balance, in that order
what_breaks_when_converting: Summary order isn't date order
check_that_catches_it: Previous - Checks - Debits + Deposits & Credits + Interest Paid = Current

how_it_typically_prints: The balance at the end of the statement period, not the balance today
what_breaks_when_converting: Compared with the live balance in online banking and taken as wrong
check_that_catches_it: Current Balance equals the next statement's Previous Balance

how_it_typically_prints: Activity grouped by kind, with a Withdrawals & Debits subhead and Date, Amount, Description columns
what_breaks_when_converting: Groups pasted one after another, out of date order
check_that_catches_it: Merge the groups, then sort by date

how_it_typically_prints: 24 months of statements online; Documents on the website, the Statements tab in the 53 Mobile Banking app
what_breaks_when_converting: A catch-up longer than two years can't be downloaded in one sitting
check_that_catches_it: Chain each ending balance to the next beginning balance; request the older months from Fifth Third

how_it_typically_prints: Typically a beginning balance with totals for checks and for withdrawals/debits
what_breaks_when_converting: Checks counted twice, once in their own total and once as debits
check_that_catches_it: Beginning + Deposits - Checks - Withdrawals/Debits = Ending

how_it_typically_prints: Daily balances on a separate page, not beside each row
what_breaks_when_converting: A converter fills a running balance the statement never printed, or reads the page as rows
check_that_catches_it: Leave the balance column empty; prove the month on the beginning and ending balance
